source.h_model_method: rest pose, the body mesh skinned at rest by the runtime importer: crown (max up) minus sole (min up), metres (every 7th vertex; sole 0.0002, crown 1.3412)

camera.frame: port model: x screen-right, y toward camera, z up; origin = character ground origin
camera.character_heading: theta = 90 - bearing about +Y (the model faces +Z); frame-0 root forward measured per cell

image.lights_detail: the Barrow's winter sun (paint_stack.gd: 55 deg, screen azimuth 305, (1.0, 0.955, 0.885), energy 0.90, shadow blur 1.7) as a child of the camera, ambient 0.30 white; self-shadowing only (no ground)

idle.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

walk.stride_method: the clip is in place at source; stride = the manifest's FOOT-LOCK speed (1.500 m/s, the speed that holds the planted foot still) x the clip length (0.6000 s)
walk.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

run.stride_method: the clip is in place at source; stride = the manifest's FOOT-LOCK speed (3.850 m/s, the speed that holds the planted foot still) x the clip length (0.4000 s)
run.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

attack_bite.skill: the roster's chomp / megachomp (melee 0-2.66 m); release = the bite contact

attack_bite_b.skill: the sideways snap variant (roster attack_b01, hit f12)

cast_spit.skill: the roster's bile vomit (aoe wave 3 m x 1 m, poison 3 s)

sockets_def.maw: the jaw tip (the chin): where the bite lands and the bile spray leaves (rig hinge -> chin, measured 0.4528 m)
sockets_def.head_top: the top of the skull: the head bone (base -> snout) + 0.25 m along it, 0.22 m up its local z
sockets_def.chest: the chest bone's head (between the shoulders)

alpha_union_bbox_convention: [x0, y0, x1, y1), x1/y1 exclusive -- PIL getchannel('A').getbbox(), as stage_art.py crops
